summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the logical validity of a frequency rate (7.2 per week) for specific terminals, suggesting it is reasonable given that users frequently pass through the same terminal daily or multiple times weekly.

[p1] questioned whether an adjustment to the frequency formula was necessary because different terminals reportedly require different calculations, noting that a single formula suitable for Brazil might not apply universally. However, [p1] later retracted this concern.
decisions: The 7.2 frequency rate per week is deemed logical based on user behavior.
